label: Each GOD_4 is a finite grounding ancestor of every actual concretum at this world
paraphrase: Open application of the causal interpretation of GOD_4. For every g satisfying the supplied God predicate and every actual concretum x at one world, a finite path of actual concrete grounds goes from g to x. The empty path is allowed for g itself. Each nonfinal node actually exists and is concrete because it supplies the next edge. The application neither posits a God nor requires one direct edge to each distinct recipient.
